dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "As the ancient sages say, all gifts come with a catch. Poison in a golden chalice is still poison, so all upstanding souls should stay on guard."

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "Such is the nature of Spirit Immersion. Immersing oneself within a spiritual object without the requisite sensitivity is akin to submerging oneself in water before even learning to wade in it. How will that teach anyone to swim?"

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "It is precisely due to such great perils that this method was declared forbidden hundreds of years ago. Be careful not to endanger your own life."

dialogues.speaker: Granny Itztli's Message
dialogues.text: "So, listen up! I'll turn whoever gets themselves into trouble into stone and chuck them right outside my door. You'll be alive, at least — and I'll treat you once I'm in a better mood."
